Subject: Request: compact SDLC evidence + runbook for SIG review

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for taking our request. Acme Health's SIG assessor team is preparing a timeboxed review and would like a compact evidence bundle focused on Secure SDLC controls (code review policy and enforcement, CI/CD pipeline controls and approvals, secrets handling and rotation, and change management approvals).

Can you provide a concise package (we typically call it a "snap pack") that includes: 1) a one-page runbook describing where to find artifacts and the steps a reviewer should follow; 2) representative artifacts (PR review log, CI job definitions, example audit log excerpt, and a secrets rotation log sample); 3) a short CSV matrix that maps control categories to artifacts; and 4) any access instructions.

Ideally delivered by EOD May 16 PST. If you can't give full logs, redacted samples or signed attestations are fine — our assessor will call out anything they need in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Lee Donovan
Security Engineer, Acme Health
security@acmehealth.com

Acme Health SIG Team

Hi team / Lee,

I've pulled the representative artifacts and assembled the runbook draft. Quick summary of what we'll include in the zip: 

1) runbook-short.pdf — ~2 pages outlining the reviewer flow: (a) start at our control matrix, (b) open PR-review-excerpt.txt for code review traces, (c) verify CI job definitions in .github/workflows/ci.yml (we include the effective job snippet), (d) check audit-log-sample.txt for deploy approvals, (e) confirm secrets rotation sample.

2) PR-review-excerpt.txt — redacted PR thread showing author, reviewers, approvals, and merge time (7 entries spanning last 90 days).

3) ci-access-matrix.csv — mapping of CI jobs -> approvers -> required checks -> token/steward. (Attached to the Drive bundle; attached here as ci-access-matrix.csv stub.)

4) audit-log-sample.txt — truncated CloudTrail-style entry showing an environment promotion and the approval principal (redacted IDs).

5) secrets-rotation-sample.csv — rotation timestamps and steward roles; does not include secrets themselves.

Also calling out controls we want to highlight:
- PR gating enforced via mandatory reviewers + automated lint/scan checks.
- CI jobs run on dedicated runner fleet with short-lived deploy tokens.
- Keystore rotation cadence is quarterly; we include rotation proof-of-event timestamps.

I'll upload to the shared Drive link and add the assessor portal entry by EOD tomorrow.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. DevOps Engineer, Redwood Inference

Couple of clarifying items for the runbook and artifacts:

- PR excerpts: include at least one example that shows an automated vuln check failure and the remediation flow (ticket -> patch -> re-run). That helps SIG reviewers understand the loop.
- CI job list: include the required approvals for deploy-stage jobs. We'll mark the specific steps that are manual approval gates.
- Audit logs: provide a single deployment transaction with timestamps, approver identity (redacted to role), and artifact hash.
- Secrets: we must not include any secret material. Provide the rotation event CSV and the KMS key alias referenced.

Mina — can you confirm whether our legal team requires an NDA for full-portal access? If so we'll route the DocuSign before giving assessor portal rights.

Marissa Cole
Director, Product Security
